high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from a photo editing app, showing a black-and-white filter applied to a photograph. The photograph itself depicts the back of a person's head and shoulders, with their hair wet and slightly disheveled. The person is standing in what looks like a bathroom or shower area, as suggested by the tiled wall in the background. The photo editing interface at the bottom of the screen indicates that the user has selected the "Eiffel" filter, which is highlighted with a checkmark. Other filter options available include "Onyx," "Vogue," and "Vista.
